entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker with a heart of fire who travels the Planes bonded to a series of trees and who parts from Six to find a new partner on Innistrad.

entities.name: Six
entities.description: Wrenn's tree partner, a treefolk who asks to return home and becomes an oak in the Kessig forest.

entities.name: Seven
entities.description: A sapling who sang to Wrenn, grows into a treefolk, and becomes her new partner after Teferi's time magic matures it.

entities.name: Four
entities.description: An earlier tree partner who was injured in battle and expelled Wrenn.

entities.name: One
entities.description: Wrenn's first tree partner, allowed to take root on another Plane.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time-magic planeswalker visiting Innistrad who joins cathars hunting a white witch, meets Wrenn, and accidentally creates a time tangle.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Local church warriors who hunt a white witch in the woods.

entities.name: Unseen presence
entities.description: A warped humanoid of man, beast and tree that follows them and is banished by Teferi's magic but leaves a tangled time spell.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The continent Teferi lost through a time spell.

entities.name: Kessig forest
entities.description: The forest on Innistrad where the finest trees grow and where Wrenn and Six first met.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of horrors, where the air is unlike any other.

events.summary: Wrenn and Six arrive in the Kessig forest near where they first met.
events.quote: put their massive foot down on the soil of Innistrad, deep within the Kessig forest

events.summary: Wrenn uproots herself from Six, who becomes an oak, ending their partnership.
events.quote: she uprooted herself and was no longer joined with Six

events.summary: Wrenn promises to return someday to find Six and offer his acorns the same choice.
events.quote: I will walk these woods again, and I will find you, old friend

events.summary: Wrenn wanders the forest following treesong toward a possible new partner.
events.quote: following the whisper of treesong that told her there was a viable partner growing here

events.summary: Cathars burst into an inn with reports of a white witch, and Teferi joins them as an excuse to leave.
events.quote: cathars from the local church came charging into the inn with reports of a white witch seen in the woods

events.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
events.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

events.summary: Wrenn explains a fire devoured her people's trees until she pulled it into herself, where it still burns.
events.quote: It devoured the trees of my people, until I found a way to pull it into myself.

events.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
events.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

events.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
events.quote: Then we walk.

events.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
events.quote: We're being followed,

events.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
events.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

events.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
events.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

events.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
events.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

events.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
events.quote: They call me Wrenn.

events.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
events.quote: I will trust you for now.

events.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
events.quote: We've made a big loop.

events.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
events.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

events.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
events.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

events.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
events.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

events.summary: Wrenn walks to an oak and dives into it, finding the sapling that sang to her.
events.quote: Wrenn was walking, step by unsteady step, toward that tree.

events.summary: The tree unfolds into a slumbering treefolk with Wrenn joined to its chest.
events.quote: it unfolded into the model of a man, a slumbering treefolk in the process of waking

events.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
events.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

events.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
events.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

events.summary: Teferi, alone, returns to the village having gained a lesson and a new ally.
events.quote: For the first time since entering these woods, Teferi was alone.

relations.quote: Then we are well met, mage

relations.note: Tree partner for a long time.
relations.quote: They were partners, not an owner and a tool.
I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

relations.note: Teferi's home continent, lost through a spell he cast.
relations.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.
